rows.label: SCENE
rows.clue: The place where some action occurs

rows.label: INFERNO
rows.clue: Any place of pain and turmoil

rows.label: FREE PORT
rows.clue: An area adjoining a port where goods that are intended for reshipment can be received and stored without payment of duties

rows.label: CITY LINE
rows.clue: The boundary of a city

rows.label: EAST SIDE
rows.clue: The side that is on the east

rows.label: PREMISES
rows.clue: Land and the buildings on it

rows.label: BACK END
rows.clue: The side of an object that is opposite its front

rows.label: HEAVENS
rows.clue: The apparent surface of the imaginary sphere on which celestial bodies appear to be projected

rows.label: SITE
rows.clue: The piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located)

rows.label: PASTURE
rows.clue: A field covered with grass or herbage and suitable for grazing by livestock

rows.label: LANDMARK
rows.clue: The position of a prominent or well-known object in a particular landscape

rows.label: OUTPOST
rows.clue: A station in a remote or sparsely populated location

rows.label: SPRAWL
rows.clue: An aggregation or continuous network of urban communities

rows.label: CREST
rows.clue: The top line of a hill, mountain, or wave

rows.label: EMPIRE
rows.clue: The domain ruled by an emperor or empress

rows.label: PORT
rows.clue: A place (seaport or airport) where people and merchandise can enter or leave a country

rows.label: LAWN
rows.clue: A field of cultivated and mowed grass

rows.label: AIR LANE
rows.clue: A designated route followed by airplanes in flying from one airport to another

rows.label: ZENITH
rows.clue: The point above the observer that is directly opposite the nadir on the imaginary sphere against which celestial bodies appear to be projected

rows.label: TREE LINE
rows.clue: Line marking the upper limit of tree growth in mountains or northern latitudes

rows.label: ROUTE
rows.clue: An established line of travel or access

rows.label: CORNER
rows.clue: A place off to the side of an area

rows.label: MIDWAY
rows.clue: The place at a fair or carnival where sideshows and similar amusements are located

rows.label: TREND
rows.clue: A general direction in which something tends to move

rows.label: CLEARING
rows.clue: A tract of land with few or no trees in the middle of a wooded area

rows.label: TACK
rows.clue: The heading or position of a vessel relative to the trim of its sails

rows.label: ZONE
rows.clue: A locally circumscribed place characterized by some distinctive features

rows.label: BUS STOP
rows.clue: A place on a bus route where buses stop to discharge and take on passengers

rows.label: ROADS
rows.clue: A partly sheltered anchorage

rows.label: RED LINE
rows.clue: A line that is colored red and that bisects an ice hockey rink

rows.label: HOME
rows.clue: Where you live at a particular time

rows.label: DESERT
rows.clue: Arid land with little or no vegetation

rows.label: MUD FLAT
rows.clue: A tract of low muddy land near an estuary

rows.label: MEADOW
rows.clue: A field where grass or alfalfa are grown to be made into hay

rows.label: TIP
rows.clue: The extreme end of something

rows.label: QUADRANT
rows.clue: A quarter of the circumference of a circle

rows.label: EXTERIOR
rows.clue: The region that is outside of something

rows.label: COMMON
rows.clue: A piece of open land for recreational use in an urban area

rows.label: CAMPUS
rows.clue: A field on which the buildings of a university are situated

rows.label: EQUATOR
rows.clue: An imaginary line around the Earth forming the great circle that is equidistant from the north and south poles

rows.label: ROUGH
rows.clue: The part of a golf course bordering the fairway where the grass is not cut short

rows.label: AIR SPACE
rows.clue: The space in the atmosphere immediately above the earth

rows.label: THICK
rows.clue: The location of something surrounded by other things

rows.label: TAX HAVEN
rows.clue: A country or independent region where taxes are low

rows.label: OPEN
rows.clue: A clear or unobstructed space or expanse of land or water

rows.label: COUNTY
rows.clue: (United Kingdom) a region created by territorial division for the purpose of local government

rows.label: FIRESIDE
rows.clue: An area near a fireplace (usually paved and extending out into a room)

rows.label: TIME ZONE
rows.clue: Any of the 24 regions of the globe (loosely divided by longitude) throughout which the same standard time is used

rows.label: OVERLOOK
rows.clue: A high place affording a good view

rows.label: BEAT
rows.clue: A regular route for a sentry or policeman

rows.label: POSITION
rows.clue: The particular portion of space occupied by something

rows.label: OUTLINE
rows.clue: The line that appears to bound an object

rows.label: DATE LINE
rows.clue: An imaginary line on the surface of the earth following (approximately) the 180th meridian

rows.label: BUS ROUTE
rows.clue: The route regularly followed by a passenger bus

rows.label: HARBOR
rows.clue: A sheltered port where ships can take on or discharge cargo

rows.label: PRECINCT
rows.clue: A district of a city or town marked out for administrative purposes

rows.label: CORN COB
rows.clue: The hard cylindrical core that bears the kernels of an ear of corn

rows.label: STAR SIGN
rows.clue: (astrology) one of 12 equal areas into which the zodiac is divided

rows.label: SETTING
rows.clue: The context and environment in which something is set

rows.label: OUTSKIRT
rows.clue: A part of the city far removed from the center

rows.label: ZODIAC
rows.clue: A belt-shaped region in the heavens on either side to the ecliptic

rows.label: JUNK PILE
rows.clue: An accumulation of refuse and discarded matter

rows.label: NOOK
rows.clue: A sheltered and secluded place

rows.label: ORBIT
rows.clue: The (usually elliptical) path described by one celestial body in its revolution about another

rows.label: TOP SIDE
rows.clue: The highest or uppermost side of anything

rows.label: AREA
rows.clue: A particular geographical region of indefinite boundary (usually serving some special purpose or distinguished by its people or culture or geography)

rows.label: STATE
rows.clue: The territory occupied by one of the constituent administrative districts of a nation

rows.label: DISTRICT
rows.clue: A region marked off for administrative or other purposes

rows.label: GOAL LINE
rows.clue: A line marking each end of the playing field or pitch

rows.label: BALK
rows.clue: The area on a billiard table behind the balkline

rows.label: TEE
rows.clue: The starting place for each hole on a golf course

rows.label: BOUNDS
rows.clue: The line or plane indicating the limit or extent of something

rows.label: OPEN AIR
rows.clue: Where the air is unconfined

rows.label: HORIZON
rows.clue: The line at which the sky and Earth appear to meet

rows.label: EARSHOT
rows.clue: The range within which a voice can be heard

rows.label: MOORING
rows.clue: A place where a craft can be made fast

rows.label: SEE
rows.clue: The seat within a bishop's diocese where his cathedral is located

rows.label: REGION
rows.clue: The extended spatial location of something

rows.label: HAUNT
rows.clue: A frequently visited place

rows.label: DUST BOWL
rows.clue: A region subject to dust storms

rows.label: APEX
rows.clue: The highest point (of something)

rows.label: INTERIOR
rows.clue: The region that is inside of something

rows.label: DIOCESE
rows.clue: The territorial jurisdiction of a bishop

rows.label: FIELD
rows.clue: A piece of land cleared of trees and usually enclosed

rows.label: PRAIRIE
rows.clue: A treeless grassy plain

rows.label: ORIGIN
rows.clue: The place where something begins, where it springs into being

rows.label: SUBURB
rows.clue: A residential district located on the outskirts of a city

rows.label: LEE SIDE
rows.clue: The side of something that is sheltered from the wind

rows.label: HOME PORT
rows.clue: The port from which a ship originates of where it is registered

rows.label: SIDE
rows.clue: A place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location

rows.label: DIG
rows.clue: The site of an archeological exploration

rows.label: SKID ROAD
rows.clue: The district of a town frequented by loggers

rows.label: LATITUDE
rows.clue: The angular distance between an imaginary line around a heavenly body parallel to its equator and the equator itself

rows.label: FLIES
rows.clue: (theater) the space over the stage (out of view of the audience) used to store scenery (drop curtains)

rows.label: SEAT
rows.clue: A space reserved for sitting (as in a theater or on a train or airplane)

rows.label: DOWN TOWN
rows.clue: The center of a city
